name: clipforge
description: Hand it a folder of talking-head clips; get back a trimmed, captioned, social-ready vertical video.

scripts.setup: npx hyperframes browser ensure && npx hyperframes models install parakeet
scripts.test:e2e: node test/make-fixtures.mjs && node bin/clipforge.mjs build test/fixtures --name fixture-run --hook "The one thing nobody tells you" --lower "Kyle Melvin|Mortgage Lender" --quality draft --force && node test/verify.mjs
